---
name: Theme submission
about: Submit a new theme to RiceHub
title: '[THEME] '
labels: theme
assignees: ''
---

**Theme Name**
The name of your theme.

**Window Manager/Desktop Environment**
Which WM/DE is this theme for? (e.g., Hyprland, Openbox, i3, KDE, GNOME, XFCE)

**Theme Description**
A brief description of your theme and its design philosophy.

**Screenshots**
Please include at least 2 screenshots showing the complete desktop setup.

**Dependencies**
List all required packages and their versions.

**Distro Compatibility**
Which Linux distributions have you tested this theme on?
- [ ] Arch Linux
- [ ] Debian/Ubuntu
- [ ] Fedora
- [ ] Other (specify)

**Theme Files**
Please provide a link to your theme repository or attach the theme files (manifest.yaml, install.sh, dotfiles).

**License**
What license is this theme released under?

**Additional Notes**
Any other information you'd like to share about your theme.
